revision_timing: Prepared after 77 Qwen judgments had already been observed. Not an ex-ante preregistration.

unresolved_explanation.partial: The frozen plan specifies composite negative/direct/other precedence using multiple raw fields, not a standalone support-only mapping for partial. Do not infer a new assignment from the 77 observed results.
unresolved_explanation.partial_support: Not an enum in the frozen Qwen prompt (which uses partial). If encountered, preserve the literal label and stop; do not silently normalize it.
unresolved_explanation.insufficient: The old composite rule generally falls through to other unless another negative condition applies. A support-only assignment to not_supported or uncertain is not explicitly frozen; leave unresolved.

allocation: Fixed group/stratum round robin, two initial passes followed by the same order to redistribute empty/small strata, until 30 distinct rows.
completion_gate: All 441 unique frozen review IDs must have completed review records with matching judgment IDs. No error/unreviewed substitute strata in the formal sample.
interpretation: Even after completion and policy resolution, this stratified audit is not an unweighted representative estimate of population accuracy.
